title: Minimum of Three Olympiad Marks
statement:
Tanu appeared in three Olympiads. The marks she scored in the three papers are given as input. Help her find the **minimum** marks among the three papers.

The marks are integers and some of them may be equal.
inputFormat: A single line containing three space-separated integers: the marks in the three Olympiads.
outputFormat: Print a single integer: the smallest of the three marks.

examples.explanation: Two marks are tied for the minimum; the answer is their common value.
A mark of zero is valid and is the minimum here.

hints: Compare the first two marks, then compare the smaller one with the third.
Equal marks need no special handling: the minimum value is the same either way.
